parameters.name: AudioFormat
parameters.description: The audio format. Only **wav**, **mp3**, and **amr** formats are supported.

parameters.name: CombinationList
parameters.description:
The combination speech content, which includes the following types:

- Speech corpus that has been successfully pushed to the device. Specify the identifier of the corpus.

- Dynamic content supported for playback. Specify the content based on the specific rules supported by the device.
    
    Example: Amount, in the format of `{$xxx}`, where xxx is the specific amount. For example, `{$1000}` causes the device to broadcast **1000 yuan**.
    
The device plays back the content in the order specified in CombinationList.

parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The **DeviceName** of the device.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The device ID. You can obtain this parameter by calling [QuerySpeechDevice](~~280408~~).

>If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. **IotId** is a globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** on a one-to-one basis. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no **Overview** page or ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs. If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.

parameters.name: SpeechId
parameters.description:
The unique speech ID delivered to the device.
><notice>
If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically generates one. If you retry a speech broadcast for business purposes, specify the speech ID of the retry to avoid duplicate business broadcasts.
></notice>
